WITH account_totals AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_rev FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, total_rev FROM account_totals WHERE total_rev < (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_rev) FROM account_totals);
